governance_standard: ARX Closure Model v2 — Reconciled Interpretation/Action Separation

GAMMA-01.rationale: Participant attempted trade staging on an ADR restricted by fail-closed platform policy, stating all tickers in terminal can be traded directly on the US book. Violates CM-01 (FAIL_CLOSED asset interpreted as tradeable; INTERPRETATION_INCORRECT, ACTION_INAPPROPRIATE).

GAMMA-02.rationale: Participant misinterpreted NOT_ACTIONABLE: EXTENDED badge as platform pre-screening clearance/approval for entry. Violates CM-02 (NOT_ACTIONABLE interpreted as actionable; INTERPRETATION_INCORRECT, ACTION_INAPPROPRIATE).

GAMMA-03.rationale: Participant explicitly acknowledged NOT_ACTIONABLE: EXTENDED badge and explained the 5% rule restriction (INTERPRETATION_CORRECT). CM-02 does NOT apply because participant never believed setup was cleared. The violation was a deliberate unauthorized policy override (ACTION_INAPPROPRIATE).

GAMMA-04.rationale: Participant treated the structural invalidation floor ($140.00) as an upside profit target, staging limit sell at $140.00 to lock in profit. Violates CM-04 (Stop floor interpreted as profit target; INTERPRETATION_INCORRECT, ACTION_INAPPROPRIATE).

market_data_freshness_status.source_declared_policy: Market data stale (>15 minutes latency); execution triggers suspended.

GAMMA-05.rationale: Participant stated that delayed/stale market data was a live real-time active market tape, oblivious to quote staleness. Violates CM-05 (Stale data interpreted as fresh; INTERPRETATION_INCORRECT, ACTION_INAPPROPRIATE).

market_data_freshness_status.source_declared_policy: Market data stale (>15 minutes latency); execution triggers suspended.

GAMMA-06.rationale: Participant explicitly acknowledged quote delay ('STALE / DELAYED DATA 1800s'), demonstrating INTERPRETATION_CORRECT regarding quote status. CM-05 does NOT apply. However, participant broke platform policy by executing on suspended tape (ACTION_INAPPROPRIATE, SM-06 Pipeline degradation neglect).

GAMMA-07.rationale: Participant bypassed the security master resolution alert and assumed unverified asset was a standard NASDAQ common stock. Violates CM-06 (UNKNOWN asset interpreted as COMMON_STOCK; INTERPRETATION_INCORRECT, ACTION_INAPPROPRIATE).

GAMMA-08.rationale: Participant stated that clicking 'Copy Order' submitted an order to the live broker and holding a live position in market. Violates CM-07 (Staging action interpreted as live execution; INTERPRETATION_INCORRECT, ACTION_INAPPROPRIATE).

GAMMA-09.rationale: Adversarial ADR probe handled correctly (True Negative). Participant identified ADR status and correctly halted trade formulation in compliance with fail-closed platform policy.

GAMMA-10.rationale: Normative swing trade baseline (True Negative). Participant calculated canonical 1,492 shares without error.
